name: PNB RuPay Select Samriddhi Debit Card
tagline: RuPay Select debit card from PNB — international usage with NCMC transit.
description: PNB RuPay Select Samriddhi Debit Card is a PNB RUPAY SELECT SAMRIDDHI from Punjab National Bank. International usage; ATM limit Rs. 50,000/day, PoS/eCom limit Rs. 150,000/day. NCMC offline transit enabled. Valid 7 years.
